nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint) holding token balances; mutated by transferFrom, batchSend and _mints.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of spending allowances; written by approve and transferFrom.
Total token supply set in the constructor; never increased by _mints.
Private privileged address assigned in constructor from msg.sender; target of the dangerous delegatecall.
Whitelisted trading address used by ensure(); writable by owner via setTradeAddress.
Mapping(address => bool) marking addresses allowed to transfer freely; set in _mints.
Counter of sales per address, incremented in transferFrom and checked in condition.
Maximum number of sales per address configured by init().
Minimum sale amount scaled by decimals, set in init().
Maximum sale amount scaled by decimals, set in init().
Payable constructor that sets name/symbol/supply, assigns owner = msg.sender and grants infinite allowance to the UNI router.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom performing unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic and calling the ensure() gate.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value without any zero-address check.
Whitelist gate granting free transfers to owner, UNI, the computed pair and canSale addresses, otherwise requiring condition().
Sale constraint check against _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
owner-only function executing arbitrary a.delegatecall(b), enabling full storage takeover.
Arbitrary mint/whitelist function callable by owner or a hardcoded address; sets balanceOf[spender] directly.
owner-only initialization of sale limits and sale count.
owner-only batch airdrop using unchecked multiplication and unchecked balance increments.
owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Internal pure CREATE2 address derivation of the Uniswap pair for the token.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance lookups, minting rights and balance transfers.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) executing attacker-chosen code in this contract's storage context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath in transferFrom, allowing underflow.
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath in transferFrom, allowing overflow.

balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals) mints arbitrary tokens without increasing totalSupply.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath in transferFrom.
balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the batchSend loop without SafeMath.

edges.reason: transfer destination parameter _to is forwarded into transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transfer amount parameter _value flows into the transferFrom call.
transfer uses msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom.
transfer delegates all logic to public transferFrom.
_from parameter is used in allowance and balance lookups of transferFrom.
_to parameter is credited in transferFrom.
_value parameter drives all arithmetic in transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared with _from and used as allowance spender, gating who may move tokens.
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before moving balances.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value is executed without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value is executed without SafeMath allowing underflow.
balanceOf[_to] += _value is executed without SafeMath allowing overflow.
ensure falls back to condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure calls pairFor to compute the Uniswap pair address used for whitelisting.
ensure consults canSale[_from] to bypass sale restrictions.
ensure compares _from with the owner-controlled tradeAddress whitelist slot.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without validating spender.
constructor derives the privileged owner from msg.sender.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged account.
delegate enforces require(msg.sender == owner) before executing.
delegate performs a.delegatecall(b) with caller-supplied target and calldata.
parameter a supplies the delegatecall target contract.
parameter b supplies the raw delegatecall payload.
delegatecall executes external code in this storage context and can overwrite owner.
_mints requires msg.sender to be owner or the hardcoded privileged address.
spender parameter selects the account credited by _mints.
addedValue parameter is scaled and written into balanceOf in _mints.
_mints assigns balanceOf[spender] arbitrarily, minting tokens out of thin air.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, whitelisting the account.
init requires msg.sender == owner before setting sale parameters.
saleNum parameter configures _saleNum in init.
token parameter configures _minSale in init.
maxToken parameter configures _maxSale in init.
init writes the computed minimum sale amount to _minSale.
init writes the computed maximum sale amount to _maxSale.
init writes the sale count limit to _saleNum.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before distributing tokens.
_tos array supplies the recipients iterated by batchSend.
_value parameter is used both in the total multiplication and per-recipient credits.
uint total = _value * _tos.length is computed without SafeMath, allowing overflow.
balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the loop is unchecked and can overflow.
batchSend debits balanceOf[msg.sender] by total and credits each recipient.
local total carries the unchecked _value * _tos.length product into the balance debit.
loop index i controls the recipient iteration in batchSend.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before changing the whitelist.
setTradeAddress assigns the owner-chosen address to tradeAddress used by ensure.
_mints writes the caller-chosen balance into the balanceOf mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: Destination parameter exists only to forward into transferFrom and can be folded into transfer.
Amount parameter is a pure pass-through to transferFrom and can be folded into transfer.
Source account parameter is only used inside transferFrom's balance/allowance logic.
Recipient parameter is only consumed by the credit arithmetic of transferFrom.
Amount parameter is a scalar input of the unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
Delegatecall target parameter exists only to feed the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Calldata parameter exists only to feed the unsafe delegatecall operation.
spender parameter only selects the mapping key written by _mints.
addedValue is the raw value written into balanceOf, defining the arbitrary mint.
saleNum parameter only configures the _saleNum state variable in init.
token parameter only derives the _minSale state value in init.
maxToken parameter only derives the _maxSale state value in init.
Recipient array parameter is only iterated by the batchSend loop.
Per-recipient amount is only used in the batchSend calculation and credits.
Local total is exactly the unchecked product _value * _tos.length that overflows.
Loop index local has no independent meaning outside the batchSend iteration.
